name: Forest Massif of Odzala-Kokoua
description: Odzala-Kokoua is a vast rainforest park in the northwest of the Republic of the Congo, where dense jungle meets open savanna clearings. Forest elephants gather in these clearings, and the park holds some of Central Africa's richest primate life, including gorillas and many monkey species. Protected since 1935, it also shows how forest has slowly spread back over grassland since the last Ice Age.
